facts.summary: Positive preliminary data disappoint investors (small n, 56% grade ≥3 TRAEs, discontinuations) · Phase 1 · MICVO in R/M head and neck squamous cell carcinoma · not yet approved
facts.indication: recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

evidence.summary: 46% confirmed objective response rate (ORR) and 92% disease control rate (DCR) observed with MICVO as monotherapy in 2L+ R/M HNSCC at 5.4 mg/kg
evidence.safety: Grade ≥3 TRAEs occurred in 56% (10/18) of patients
